name: job-decision-career-navigation
description: Polski system zdobywania pracy — Job Decision & Career Navigation System

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate:migrations && npm test && npm run verify:backup-restore && npm run test:browser
scripts.dev: npm run build && NODE_ENV=development node --watch --enable-source-maps dist/server/index.js
